messages.author: 91fcdff1323a6831
messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: R Package or script to create a scatter plot of and
parts:
Sorry I'm a bit late to this chain, but a few excellent examples of doing exactly this are in the posts below. The first few use emoji packages to create icons you can assign to a given data/factor type.  The last one shows how you might use anything you want (that is an icon sized .png) and use rasterGrobs to plot various layers.
  • http://masalmon.eu/2017/02/18/complot/ (uses the magick and emojifont packages)
  • http://livefreeordichotomize.com/2017/02/09/the-prevalence-of-drunk-podcasts/ (uses the emoGG package)
  • http://citizen-statistician.org/2015/10/27/halloween-an-excuse-for-plotting-with-icons/
R
